title: I made fantasy football for cars
author: Tommybangsta
selftext:
Strictly no hypercars—just classic and attainable performance cars from the 80s to modern day.

• How it works: Each week has a theme (starting with an Open House week). Pick a 3-car garage under a budget cap, lock in before the deadline, and battle head-to-head in 1v1 arenas where the community votes on who built the better setup.

• Tech stack: Built as a lightweight browser app using Lovable

You can try it out instantly without creating an account (guest play is enabled).

Play here: garage-wars-app.lovable.app

Would love any feedback from fellow car lovers and devs!
